verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent stack lets users grant scoped, revocable permissions to an agent's signer key or card—spend caps, counterparties, time windows, and expiration—enforced onchain or via card-network rails, matching the least-privilege credential story closely (crossmint-supp-4, crossmint-supp-2, crossmint-supp-8, crossmint-docs-13, crossmint-docs-49). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and explicit scoping of traditional API keys (only client/server key docs exist, not agent-specific API-key scoping).
